predecessors.name: Srivijaya
predecessors.text: the Malay Peninsula land of Srivijaya's last Cliopatria shape that the Malaya shape of 1294 covers

successors.name: Majapahit
successors.text: the Malay Peninsula states, Majapahit's tributary sphere from 1352

ledger.x: 1294: the Malay principalities of the peninsula appear in Cliopatria.
c. 1299: Singapore island is Singapura's. Infobox of the Kingdom of Singapura page 'Founding of Temasek by Sang Nila Utama: 1299'; Cliopatria takes the two island cells out of Malaya in 1305.
1351: the peninsula passes to Majapahit's sphere.

wars.name: Sukhothai and Majapahit claims on the peninsula
wars.outcome: No fighting or border is dated on the pages opened; Sukhothai's claim is placed in the late 13th century and Majapahit's in the 14th century (History of Malaysia), with the 1365 Nagarakretagama as the first list.

certainty.note: A regional aggregate of small Malay principalities with no recorded frontier; every edge is approximate.
